_comment: The canonical seat roster, the spellings observed in the wild, and the retired seats.
Read by scripts/hooks/role-card-inject.ps1 and by tests/test_role_cards.py.
JSON rather than TOML, against the CLAUDE.md section 7 default, for one concrete reason:
PowerShell reads JSON with a built-in and has no TOML parser, and this file has to be read
by both a hook and a pytest. Keys are lowercase; the hook lowercases before it looks up.
The roster comes from CLAUDE.md section 5. The vault's roles/README.md disagrees and is the
stale one -- it still lists seven retired seats as live and calls itself a partial list.
The alias keys were MEASURED on 2026-09-05 across 968 worktree seat records, which held 46
distinct strings for a six-seat roster. Do not add a spelling nobody has actually used.

retired.dispatcher: retired by CLAUDE.md section 5 on 2026-09-01; the Console reads the backlog and cuts briefs
retired.liaison: retired by CLAUDE.md section 5 on 2026-09-01; seats reach the owner through the Console
retired.pm: retired by CLAUDE.md section 5 on 2026-09-01; the Console holds reporting
